_note: One-shot transform: the WaltGalmarini master -> the Medek Hungarian master. Run once by derive.py; its output is templates/master/, which is thereafter the source of truth. Kept committed so 'where did 15 - Abra's spacing come from?' has an answer.
_source_note: Read-only. Never modified. Belongs to that job, not to this repo.
_styleid_note: Note the source styleIds have already lost their umlauts - Word strips non-ASCII when it generates a styleId, which is why '21 - Uberschrift 1' is stored as '21-berschrift1'. The new ids follow the same ASCII rule deliberately: w:styleId is internal and never displayed, w:name carries the Hungarian.
_prefix_note: The numbered prefix is load-bearing, not decoration. On a Hungarian Word, the built-in heading displays as 'Címsor 1'; a custom style also named 'Címsor 1' would collide and you would get two styles fighting in the gallery. '21 - Címsor 1' cannot collide in any UI language. It also sorts the gallery usefully, which is why WG adopted it.

add._note: Statutory declaration paragraphs. Slightly looser leading than body text because it is read as a legal statement, not scanned.

Normal._why: THE IMAGE FIX. Was exact 300 = a line box pinned at 15pt, which clips any taller inline image. atLeast at the same 300 renders identically for ordinary text and grows only where exact would have cut.

12-Infoszoveg._why: image safety - a user may paste into an info paragraph

31-Felsorolas-pont._why: image safety - a user may paste into a bullet

21-Cimsor1._why: was after=3000 twips = 150pt of white space after every chapter title. Almost certainly a WG house layout choice tied to their marginal column; absurd in an A4 permit document.

Heading1._why: same 3000-twip problem. Hidden from the gallery so 21 - Címsor 1 is the one people pick, but kept defined because TOCHeading is basedOn it and Word expects built-in headings to exist.

15-Abra._why: keepNext holds the picture on the same page as its caption. next means pressing Enter after a picture lands you in the caption style - WG's next is body text, which is why every caption there is a manual style pick.

Caption._why: Word's own Insert > Caption applies the built-in Caption style. Retuning it to match the office caption means that route gives the office look instead of stock Word blue. The built-in NAME cannot be changed - Word identifies it by the canonical English 'caption' - but its formatting can.

add_numbering._note: Style-linked automatic caption numbering. A w:pStyle back-link inside the numbering level means that simply APPLYING the style numbers the paragraph - no Insert > Caption dialog, no per-document setup. Hungarian convention puts the number first: '1. ábra:', not 'Ábra 1'.

numbering_text._note: lvlText values carried over from WG that contain German words. 'Anhang %1' prefixes every appendix heading with the German for annex. Stripped to a bare number so the style works in any language - the heading text itself says what it is.

global._note: Applied to docDefaults, theme1.xml minor/major fonts, fontTable.xml, and every explicit w:rFonts / w:lang in styles.xml.
